items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 17 at 4:33AM EST until November 20 at 7:00AM EST by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 knots with gusts up to 35 knots and
seas 4 to 7 feet.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
